card.name: Linking words before brand names of MS drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (or, in, to, and, a comma, an opening bracket) that come right before a brand or company name, mostly multiple sclerosis drugs such as REBIF, AVONEX, OCREVUS and similar comparators.

modes.label: Comparison words in MS trials
modes.description: A word like or, in, than or to in a comparison that is about to name another MS drug or placebo.
modes.example: patients experienced respiratory tract infections compared to patients taking REBIF<< or>> placebo.

modes.label: Bracket or list link before a maker or brand
modes.description: An opening bracket, comma or and in a list of drugs or companies, just before the next brand or manufacturer name.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting a brand or company name next, though the promoted tokens are mixed and not very informative.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the next drug brand or company name, especially in MS drug comparisons and brand lists.
